answer_1.quote: the problem of the court's view generation can be formulated as a text-to-text natural language generation (NLG) problem
datasets: we build a dataset based on raw civil legal documents
answer_1.outputs: Court's view including judgment and rationales

answer_2.quote: ROUGE 4 is a set of metrics used in the NLP task. We keep the results of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L. BLEU 5 is a method of automatic text-generation evaluation... BERT SCORE computes a similarity score by using contextual embedding of the tokens.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We conduct a human evaluation to better analyze the quality of the generated court's view. First, we randomly sample 500 test cases... to 5 human annotators with legal backgrounds.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to give a score (1-5) on the judgment in the generated court's view... 1 for totally wrong and 5 for totally correct. (2) Rational level... 1 for the worst and 5 for the best. (3) Fluency level... 1 for the worst and 5 for the best.
